label: REAL PROFILES written and reviewed by gpt-4.1-mini from real Census draws. The residents are simulated.

census.source: ACS 2024 5 year PUMS (2020 to 2024), Census API (https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5/pums)

homes.source: tract counts: ACS 2024 5 year B01003, B03002, B25008, B26001, Census API; tracts in the PUMA: Census 2020 tract to PUMA relationship file; population centers: Census 2020; neighborhoods: City of Syracuse open data
homes.method: tract drawn with probability proportional to people in the tract with the resident's race and Hispanic origin times the tract's share with the resident's tenure (treated as independent within a tract; all ages); neighborhood is the one containing the tract's population center

hand_read.by: Claude agent, reading all 20 profiles against their records on 2026-11-11; an agent read, not a human label
